old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a cluster of pink blossoms, likely cherry blossoms, set against a bright, overexposed background. The sunlight filters through the leaves, creating a soft, ethereal glow that enhances the delicate texture of the petals. The camera exhibits a slow, subtle movement or drift throughout the sequence, altering the framing of the flowers and leaves. The leaves, some tinged with yellow, provide a subtle contrast to the pink hues of the flowers. The overall effect is one of tranquility and natural beauty, with the interplay of light and shadow highlighting the ephemeral nature of the blossoms.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a cluster of pink blossoms, likely cherry blossoms, set against a bright, overexposed background. The sunlight filters through the leaves, creating a soft, ethereal glow that enhances the delicate texture of the petals. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the intricate details of the flowers and their vibrant colors. The blossoms sway gently in the breeze, adding a dynamic element to the otherwise still scene. The leaves, some tinged with yellow, provide a subtle contrast to the pink hues of the flowers. The overall effect is one of tranquility and natural beauty, with the interplay of light and shadow highlighting the ephemeral nature of the blossoms.
caption: The video captures a heavily overexposed, dreamy close-up of a flowering branch, with pink double cherry blossoms on the left beneath yellow-green leaves against a blown-out pale sky. The floral subject drifts slowly upward and slightly rightward within the frame, the upper leaves becoming progressively more cropped at the top edge while the layout of leaves to blossoms stays roughly constant. As the bright, hazy glare shifts across the image, the pink blossoms grow somewhat more defined and saturated toward the middle before softening again. A small green-teal chromatic flare appears on the upper-right leaf and persists. A soft white circular lens-flare disc emerges near the right edge of the blossom cluster, moving slightly relative to the flowers. Slight positional shifts affect the leaves and blossoms throughout.

endpoints are normal, not physical errors. Do not add unseen causes, onset, stopping or outcomes.
An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.
Do not claim contact, bending, compression, melting, disintegration or structural recovery unless
the appropriate material/surface itself provides visible evidence. Do not infer a force or earlier
collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.
Compare several frames before asserting translation, rotation, direction, unchanged position or
camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

Retain the WISA English narrative style, detail density and paragraph structure. Aim for the
provided original word count within 85%-115%, using genuinely visible details and process.
Do not add repetition, watermark/logo descriptions or atmospheric filler to reach a word count.

'this mid-segment', 'the excerpt', 'the frame', 'these images', 'observed evidence' in the caption.
This is a direct video description, not an analysis note. No mandatory beginning/end formula.
Complete every sentence. If accuracy requires a substantial length difference, explain it outside
the caption; do not fill missing context by imagination. Optional synonym edits are not needed.
